title: A tray icon that matches your panel
highlights: The tray shows the rabbit as a monochrome symbol instead of the white app badge, like the desktop's own status icons.
It follows the KDE color scheme: light on dark panels such as Breeze Dark, dark on light ones.
Includes 0.1.17: Bluetooth mice and keyboards are picked up again after reconnecting, and Left Shift+Escape or Escape three times takes control back.
